title: All-Inclusive Utility Package Terms Sheet: Monthly Fee, Allowances and Overage Multiplier

# All-Inclusive Utility Package — Fee, Allowances and Overage Multiplier (Utility Services Program)

The Utility Services Program offers one package program, the All-Inclusive Utility Package. It carries a monthly package fee, a monthly usage allowance for water, natural gas and electricity, and a multiplier applied to the submetered rates for usage above the allowances. No other program carries a package fee, allowances or an overage multiplier.

| Program | Monthly package fee | Water included per month | Gas included per month | Electricity included per month | Overage rate multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Essentials Utility Plan | $0.00 | 0.00 thousand gallons | 0.00 therms | 0 kWh | 0.00 |
| Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan | $0.00 | 0.00 thousand gallons | 0.00 therms | 0 kWh | 0.00 |
| Submetered Water Plan | $0.00 | 0.00 thousand gallons | 0.00 therms | 0 kWh | 0.00 |
| Submetered Water & Gas Plan | $0.00 | 0.00 thousand gallons | 0.00 therms | 0 kWh | 0.00 |
| Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan | $0.00 | 0.00 thousand gallons | 0.00 therms | 0 kWh | 0.00 |
| All-Inclusive Utility Package | $165.00 | 4.00 thousand gallons | 25.00 therms | 650 kWh | 1.00 |

## Package figures in words

- The monthly package fee of the All-Inclusive Utility Package is $165.00.
- Its monthly allowances are 4.00 thousand gallons of water, 25.00 therms of gas and 650 kilowatt-hours of electricity.
- Its overage rate multiplier is 1.00: usage above an allowance is priced at the submetered rate multiplied by 1.00.

*Illustration (hypothetical month):* a full month on the All-Inclusive Utility Package in which the home used 3.2 thousand gallons of water, 18 therms of gas and 610 kWh of electricity stays inside all three monthly allowances of 4.00 thousand gallons, 25.00 therms and 650 kWh.
